verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an agent plugin ecosystem, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers installing and invoking plugins and skills inside interactive Chat, Work or Codex sessions. Nothing documents scheduled or autonomous background runs. A plugin-level `hooks.json` file and MCP event-subscription/webhook docs exist, but these are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not a user-facing automation capability, so they earn no credit.
